**TL;DR:** The 28cf7be 2B verification run died at STM round 1 with a verbatim "torch.OutOfMemoryError: CUDA out of memory. Tried to allocate 3.00 GiB" (flex backward index_put during stm_epoch; StmConfig.micro_batch=256 was tuned for the old dense attention, and the run's autotuner had already picked 64 for training). Per user instruction, STM and SFT loops now auto-shrink instead of dying: new shrink_micro_batch (halve, floor 1) in stm.py; stm_epoch and run_sft catch torch.OutOfMemoryError, clear the CUDA cache, halve the micro batch, retry the same slice, and only re-raise at micro batch 1. 197 tests pass, lint/pyaot clean.

**Long description:** The crashed run had completed warmup + full 2B training (61,036 steps at micro 64 — note the shared-indexer model autotunes to micro 64, not 256, because flex selection buffers cost more activation memory) and died entering STM, which blindly used config micro_batch 256. Proving tests written first and seen failing (ImportError on shrink_micro_batch): stm_epoch with a monkeypatched per_sample_loss that raises OutOfMemoryError for batches > 2 completes and returns all 16 finite losses; run_sft with a flaky MythosMini.forward raising once for batches > 4 completes its epoch; halving truth table. The training loop already had its own shrink (shrink_after_oom, micro−5 with grad-accum compensation) — untouched. The crashed run dir runs/20260611_15xx has all training checkpoints; superseded by the relaunch below rather than resumed (STM must rerun from the latest checkpoint anyway).

**What worked:** Tests red then green; LINT_OK; pyaot 74 files; 197 passed.

**What failed:** Nothing in this unit beyond the original crash being reproduced conceptually in tests.

**What was kept / discarded:** Kept both shrink loops, the helper, tests, doc updates. Crashed run's STM phase discarded; relaunching the full 2B verification run.

**Open questions / next steps:** STM round timings will lengthen when shrink engages (smaller batches); fine. Relaunched run will produce the scores.md row for 28cf7be + this fix.
